Mount Zion United Methodist Church. Two story brick church
with front gable, pedimented entry, large steeple, 1990s
addition. 1930s log structure, 1910 Civil War monument, and
cemetery on site. The curch was organized around 1830 in
the Magnolia Estates area and moved to its current location
around 1835. The current two-story church building (the fifth
for the congregation) was constructed in 1954 with a low front
gable roof and large steeple.

[UMC cont'd] The entry is covered by a pediment supported
by two-story columns. The federal-style double door entry is
surrounded by large windows on the first and second floors.
The sanctuary features two-story windows. Its associated
cemetery is also located on the site with an additional
memorial cemtery across Smith Road (Cornelius Jaycees
1971).
